problem: The function $v(t)=8{e}^{t/2}$ gives the volume, in cubic centimeters, of methylated spirit produced by a chemical process $t$ hours after the process begins. Find the instantaneous rate of change of spirit volume as a function of $t.$
worked_solution:
The instantaneous rate of change of the spirit volume is equal to ${v}^{′}(t).$

Now, the rate of change of $v(t)$ with respect to $t$ is

$$
\begin{aligned}{v}^{′}(t) & =\frac{\text{d}}{\text{d}t}(8{e}^{t/2}) \\  & =\frac{1}{2}\cdot (8{e}^{t/2}) \\  & =4{e}^{t/2}.\end{aligned}
$$

Therefore, the instantaneous rate change of the volume of spirit with respect to time is $4{e}^{t/2}$ cubic centimeters per hour.
